summary: Master LDI strategies, interest rate swaps, and inflation hedging to stabilize pension fund solvency. Practical 5-day course for investment professionals.
lede: Pension liability hedging aligns investment exposures with the value and sensitivities of future benefit payments. For pension investment, actuarial, treasury and risk professionals, the course covers building liability benchmarks, measuring interest-rate and inflation sensitivities, and using swaps, bonds and collateral plans to manage exposure and liquidity.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the financial health and risk management of defined benefit pension schemes.
audience: Asset Liability Management (ALM) Specialist in corporate
modules: Pension Liability Profiles and Discounting Foundations
Measuring Liability Sensitivity and Risk Metrics
Interest Rate Hedging with Swaps and Bonds
Inflation Hedging and Real Rate Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of fixed income mathematics, including bond pricing and duration. Familiarity with basic pension fund accounting and actuarial concepts is recommended. No prior experience with complex derivatives is required, but an intermediate level of Excel proficiency is necessary for the practical exercises.
